hero.eyebrow: Small Groups · Fixed Departures · Real Savings
hero.lead: Join fellow travelers on fixed-date group tours across the Sahara, the Atlas Mountains, and Morocco's imperial cities — shared rides, shared riads, shared memories, and none of the private-tour markup.

sections.lead: Choose a trip length and starting city. Every route is designed for easy solo booking and sociable group travel.

sections.h2: Desert sunsets, blue medinas, mountain roads
All the adventure, none of the private-tour price tag
sections.lead: We run the same iconic routes as private operators — Sahara camel treks, the Atlas Mountains, the blue streets of Chefchaouen — but you share the vehicle, the guide, and the cost with a small group of fellow travelers.

cards.title: 4-Day Sahara Desert Group Tour
cards.blurb: Ait Benhaddou, Dades & Todra Gorges, a camel trek into the dunes, and a night under the stars at a shared desert camp.

cards.title: 7-Day Morocco Highlights Group Tour
cards.blurb: Marrakech, the High Atlas, Sahara dunes, Fes medina, and the blue lanes of Chefchaouen — Morocco's greatest hits in one loop.

cards.title: More routes joining the calendar
cards.blurb: We're adding new shared departures from Fes, Agadir, and Tangier. Get in touch and we'll let you know the moment they open.

sections.h2: Shared group day trips from Marrakech & Fes
sections.lead: Short on time or budget? Join a shared minivan day trip — or just a shared local guide on foot — instead. Same small-group savings, no overnight required. Departs daily from €18.

cards.title: Marrakech Medina Walking Tour
cards.blurb: Jemaa el-Fnaa, the souks, Bahia Palace, and the Koutoubia Mosque with a local guide, on foot.

cards.title: Chefchaouen Blue City Day Trip
cards.blurb: Morocco's iconic blue-washed streets in the Rif Mountains, our most-booked day trip from Fes.

cards.title: Agafay Desert Sunset Day Trip
cards.blurb: Camel ride and golden-hour views over the stone desert, just 40 minutes from the city.

sections.h2: Booking a shared trip is simple

steps.title: Pick a route
steps.text: Browse fixed-date group departures and find one that fits your dates.

steps.title: Reserve your seat
steps.text: Secure your spot with a small deposit — no need to fill the group yourself.

steps.title: Meet the group
steps.text: We'll add you to a pre-departure chat so you can meet your travel companions.

steps.title: Hit the road
steps.text: A local guide and driver handle the logistics — you just show up and enjoy it.

cta.h2: Ready to join the next group?
cta.p: Fixed departures fill up fast, especially in peak season. Grab your seat today.
